method: Reuse the validated first-run Datadog worktree/output/scratch paths. Copy original immutable metadata/CAS into a new root. Stabilize minimal then toplevel with one mutable copied local cache/catalog; final pass must write zero. Fresh JVM and synchronous clean before every build; empty graph/outputs/action cache checked. Same remote action cache/BES; no disk cache. New binary for local and remote. After stabilization, identical frozen local seed and remote catalog. Fresh staging cache each run. Remote backend restart and one full read/idempotent-commit warmup excluded from timers; new commit writes not warmed. Pilot excluded. Rotating three-arm minimal/toplevel measurements. Metadata proxy counts gRPC wire bytes, separate from action-cache gRPC logs.

fixture_reuse.cas_seed: immutable CAS files hardlinked; catalog independently copied
